speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are suffering from severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and dysuria. To better understand your condition, have you noticed any blood in your urine or changes in the color of your urine?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. She reports pain with urination and also experienced burning pain during sexual intercourse 3 days ago. She mentions being sexually active with one male partner, using condoms inconsistently.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID).

Based on your 17-year-old age, history of inconsistent condom use, severe lower abdominal pain, and dysuria, these are classic signs of an infection spreading to the uterus or fallopian tubes. I need to confirm the extent of the infection. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis and Urine Culture. REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic Ultrasound.
